goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE: first use the select tool to select 'MAIN-001 - Main Office' in the Branch dropdown (required, do not skip), then type operator ID 'teller1', then type password 'password', then click Sign On. After reaching the main menu, click the 'Member Inquiry' link. On the Member Inquiry / Selection screen, type the member number '100234' into the search value field (the 'Search by' dropdown is already set to Member Number, leave it as is), then click Search. In the results, click the 'Select' link for member 100234. On the member record page, extract the member's full name (the value next to the 'Name:' label) as an output named member_name. Then extract the exact dollar balance shown in the FIRST row of the SHARES / BALANCES table (the row for share 100234-S0001) as an output named balance -- use role 'cell' and the exact dollar text you see for that row's balance cell. Then call done referencing both outputs.
final_summary: Signed on to MERIDIAN CORE with branch MAIN-001, operator teller1, navigated to Member Inquiry, searched for member 100234, selected the member, and extracted the member name (Lovelace, Ada) and the balance of the first share row [REDACTED] ($1,500.00).
